briefdescription.para: Wave D — Replication Dedicated Gate Benchmarks (REP-BM-01..04).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency and throughput measurements for the four Wave D replication hot paths identified in src/replication/ROADMAP.md.

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: Bounded queue enqueue under sustained load; gate: p95 ≤ 50 µs
Replication slot LSN advance latency; gate: p95 ≤ 20 µs
CDC event publish rate; gate: ≥ 100 000 events/sec
WAL segment enqueue throughput; gate: ≥ 50 000 segments/sec
